name: BASTA! Fall 2027
description: .NET, C#, Azure and AI conference week in Mainz
note: on-site or remote livestream; German and English; dates only on dev.events, official site still shows 2026
dateNote: last edition 28 Sep - 2 Oct 2026 (workshops 28 Sep and 2 Oct)
details:
BASTA! is the Software & Support Media conference for .NET, C#, Azure, web and AI, with a spring edition (stored separately) and a fall edition in Mainz.

The 2026 fall edition ran at the Rheingoldhalle Mainz, main conference 29 Sep - 1 Oct with workshop days around it, on-site or remote with livestream; cheapest 2026 ticket was a workshop day from 629 EUR plus VAT. dev.events lists 28 Sep - 1 Oct 2027; the official site has no 2027 page yet.
